Representation (wallboard + anomaly aggregation + timestamped event stream) matches the shape bundle nearly exactly.

primary_task_salience.evidence: The metric wall occupies ~75-80% width and full height in screenshots/1280x860.png and screenshots/1440x900.png; the anomaly strip is placed directly under the header as the first visual landing point (index.html:29-33, comment '扫视第一落点'), the header carries a live anomaly counter '异常 0/24 · 转换 0' (app.js:124-125), and critical tiles/chips pulse (style.css:112, 197-201).

context_loss.evidence: Selection renders into the persistent right rail while the wall stays fully visible and the selected tile keeps an outline (style.css:208; app.js:345-364); Esc closes without any navigation (app.js:425); inspector history preserves scroll position across rebuilds (app.js:323, 342); feed is append-only with no auto-scroll (app.js:221-249) — no routes, modals, or reloads exist in the source.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces: header (pause/inject/stats), anomaly strip, metric wall, event feed, footer — all justified by the high-temporality monitor job (screenshots). Deduction: the inspector region is permanently visible in its empty placeholder state ('—' name/badge, ✕ close, '变化追溯' heading) in both screenshots even though nothing is selected, because index.html:41 sets hidden but style.css:218-225 declares .insp { display:flex }, which overrides the UA [hidden] rule — dead surface ≈62% of the rail at boot.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt (measurement-summary.json): a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (3 pass / 4 fail overall). Source shows real a11y intent — semantic <button> tiles (app.js:56), :focus-visible outlines (style.css:27-28), dynamic aria-labels on status change (app.js:159), aria-pressed filter (app.js:417), role=button + keyboard handlers on feed rows (app.js:230-235), prefers-reduced-motion (style.css:308-311) — but the objective checks fail, consistent with 9-10px type (style.css:176, 231-234, 29-31) and dim palette (--dim #5c6878 on #151d26, style.css:9,5).

frontend_rework.evidence: Two visible defects confirmed in both screenshots and traceable in source: (1) empty inspector panel permanently shown — .insp display:flex defeats the hidden attribute (style.css:218-225 vs index.html:41); (2) anomaly strip all-clear note never renders at boot: lastStripSig initialized '' equals the empty signature, so the build branch is skipped (app.js:19, 181-190, 207-209) and the strip shows only the '异常' caption with an empty body despite '异常 0/24'. Receipt adds 4 failed checks implying rework (a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size); layout checks pass (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation).

scores.overall_note: The package is a purpose-built metric duty wall ('PulseWall 指标值班墙') that fits the brief's monitor × volatile-evidence-stream shape almost canonically: a fixed-position 24-tile wall with sparklines, deltas and status colors, an anomaly aggregation strip as the first glance landing point, an always-on timestamped event feed, and a selection-driven inspector whose timestamped change history directly serves the acceptance seed '指标变化可追溯'. Anti-flicker is engineered, not cosmetic — hysteresis margins, minimum dwell, 3-tick recovery confirmation, membership-gated strip rebuilds and a 500ms-then-static value pulse (stream.js:118-142, app.js:181-209, style.css:210-215). Navigation and context costs are minimal (one click/Enter from wall to evidence, side-rail inspection that never leaves the wall). The weaknesses are concrete and visible: the empty inspector renders at boot because its display:flex overrides the hidden attribute, and the anomaly strip's all-clear summary never renders due to a signature-initialization collision (app.js:19) — both observable in both screenshots — and the measurement receipt fails all four a11y-related checks (contrast, focus_order, target_size, min projected type size), consistent with the 9-10px type and dim palette in style.css. Model-judged proxy only: time_to_understand is not human preference, and task time, retrieval accuracy, and preference remain not observable in this blind pilot.
